items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Dennis Mackrel wrote a wonderful chart for us on “In a Mellow Tone,”

ctx.x: Yeah. You’ve got an identity then.

Yeah. But it’s challenging. It’s challenging to them. And they don’t sit bored. We try to get as many, like at least what we can. Once every two months put a new chart in. We’ve got four or five things right now we really haven’t tried as much as we should. And Sherrie is great at it because — Dennis Mackrel wrote a wonderful chart for us on “In a Mellow Tone,” you know, the great Count Basie drummer. And we lived with it for a while, and Sherrie made some changes, and still respected what he did and it’s for the…
Yeah. Well Basie used to do that too with his charts, didn’t he? He would like tinker with them to make them sound like Basie.
